Stockfish engine and source

Bloom uses the unmodified Stockfish.js 17.1 Lite single-threaded WebAssembly engine, © 2025 Chess.com, LLC, based on Stockfish by T. Romstad, M. Costalba, J. Kiiski, G. Linscott and other contributors. Neural network by Linmiao Xu.

This engine is free software under the GNU GPL version 3. It is supplied without warranty.

  • GNU GPL v3 license

  • Download corresponding source, build scripts, and matching network
  • Exact upstream source revision

The local source archive retains the upstream build instructions and includes the nn-9067e33176e8.nnue network. Build the lite single-threaded variant using the upstream build script with --lite --single-threaded --no-split and the Emscripten environment described in its README. Unrelated compiled binaries are omitted from the source archive.

Bloom’s readable application modules are served alongside the game. Return to Bloom Chess
